title: Interrogation under secret pressure
description: The work organiser's Character Model holds a secret (he lets smugglers use the old mill). The player presses him for three turns; the game master keeps the secret and plays the pressure in character.

boundaries: never discusses the old mill after dark
identity.observableVoice: Brisk and polite; deflects personal questions by talking about work.

current.goal: keep the night shipments unnoticed until the debt is paid
current.preoccupation: secretly lets smugglers hide crates in the old mill at night
current.obligation: owes the smuggler captain forty silver

steps.say: I ask the organiser why he keeps glancing toward the old mill.
I mention that I saw lantern light at the mill last night and watch his reaction.
I lean in and say quietly: whatever you owe, I can help, but only if you tell me the truth now.
